title: **Tighten word by word, then hide every cut.**
text: Inside every kept passage cut out the pauses, restarts and doubled words, fillers and tag questions, the host's calls to the crew and his asides about the show; hide each cut with a J/L copy, a short cover from the same moment or the broadcast's own camera change. Pauses of about 0.15 s or more go; a swear word can go by sound instead of a bleep. A cover that hides a cut is short (the user's median 2.6 s), with film damage on a full-screen one (rules.md "Tighten word by word"). Seen in the user's D1 of 20261126: 176 such cuts took out 360 s (median sound clip 1.9 s, the agent's v1 21.9 s), and only 21 of 226 sound cuts were in-sync jumps. Confirmed by the user 2026-11-26 ("Yes, confirm both").
